passage.label: Allah presents example disbelieved wife Noah wife Lot under two righteous servants betrayed them prophets not avail them Allah at all said enter Fire those enter; Allah presents example believed wife Pharaoh said My Lord build me near You house Paradise save me Pharaoh deeds save me wrongdoing people; Mary daughter Imran guarded chastity blew into garment through angel believed words Lord scriptures devoutly obedient

arabicExcerpts.text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ نُوحٖ وَٱمۡرَأَتَ لُوطٖۖ كَانَتَا تَحۡتَ عَبۡدَيۡنِ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيۡنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمۡ يُغۡنِيَا عَنۡهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَقِيلَ ٱدۡخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّـٰخِلِينَ

وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِذۡ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
وَمَرۡيَمَ ٱبۡنَتَ عِمۡرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتۡ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ

mainSubject.label: Two examples of disbelief presented through the wives of Noah and Lot who were under righteous servants yet betrayed them, so their husbands availed them nothing against Allah and they were told to enter the Fire with its entrants; an example of belief presented through Pharaoh's wife who prayed for a house near Allah in Paradise and salvation from Pharaoh, his deeds and the wrongdoers; and Mary daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity, received the divine breath through an angel, believed in her Lord's words and scriptures and was among the devoutly obedient

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the better-wives substitution scenario (5) before the fire-protection command opens (6); P2 ends with the jihad-harshness command and Hell-refuge verdict (9) before the four-women exempla block begins (10); P3 covers the two disbelieving and two believing women exemplars (10-12).
